status: Implementation preparation; no server training or evaluation yet.
checkpoint_selection: Same original ordinary predeclared score and strict greater-than tie rule; fixed repeat0 only.
reference_policy: All recorded positives including unknown: R>=4 without replacement; R<4 include all then replacement fill; independently random permutation. Empty TRAIN sets reject startup.
comparison_limit: Equal gradient path slots are not equal full-positive supervision access, FLOPs, training time, or online latency. No average-path causality or novelty claim.
fixed_last_train_stage: Independent root-triggered stage,285 requests/1140 candidates/11400 denoiser calls; never automatic training extension.

denoising_diagnostic.input_order: first six actual TRAIN indices in canonical dataset order
denoising_diagnostic.scope: Teacher positive noising diagnostic, not normal generation; no extra training or model selection.

final_repeats: Repeat0 reuses saved selected pool; repeats1/2 independently evaluated. Same best/last checkpoint reuses pool. Never merge K4 pools.
